note: This document is the campaign's denominator. The runner reads it to decide what must run and what each report must have observed, and the in-process reconciliation in crates/oxide-batch/tests/m5_upgrade_campaign.rs reads it to decide whether it still says what the accepted documents require. M6 #144 added 0005_item_stream_component_state.sql (schema 4) on top of the M5-era schema 3 this document originally described; the schema-3 source, the current-schema target, and the second historical runtime below are the reconciliation for that addition, not a redefinition of the M5-era paths, which are preserved as the schema-1 and schema-2 sources always were.

schema2_runtime.note: The last revision before schema 3 was added. The rejection report builds this revision in a worktree because no build of the current tree can report a supported schema version of 2.

schema3_runtime.note: The last revision before schema 4 was added (M6 #144's 0005_item_stream_component_state.sql). The rejection report builds this revision in a worktree because no build of the current tree can report a supported schema version of 3.

sources.note: Installed by running the immutable migration set to version 1 and stopping, so the fixture is the schema those migrations produced rather than a later schema wearing an older number.
Installed by running the immutable migration set to version 2 and stopping.

related.note: The lower-level regression test for the comparison the rejection report exercises end to end. It is kept and must keep existing, and this campaign does not run it: it needs a database already migrated to the current schema, which is the crash-and-restore campaign's fixture rather than this one's, and every database this campaign touches it creates itself. It is also not a substitute for the report, because it moves a version number one past whatever this runtime supports, where the report runs previous runtimes against real databases at the current schema.
